transliteration: ādhyartham ādhilekhyaṃ syād dāsārthaṃ dāsapatrakam // BrhS_1,6.9 //
sph_interpretive_translation: For securing a loan, a debt acknowledgment document shall exist; for acquiring a servant, a servitude agreement shall be established.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises through documented mutual consent aligned with Dharma
Causation is established via conscious contractual intentionality
Capacity-based responsibility requires clarity in role-bound agreements
Restoration logic ensures all transactions support spiritual evolution
Consciousness alignment mandates transparency in relational obligations
executable_legal_axioms: IF a financial obligation exists THEN it MUST be recorded in writing as per Dharma
IF a service relationship is entered THEN it MUST be codified without exploitation
NO undocumented claim shall hold validity in judicial review
ALL agreements MUST align with the higher purpose of liberation (moksha)
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudicates based on whether the written instrument reflects conscious Dharma-aligned intent. Responsibility lies only where capacity was knowingly exercised. All disputes must resolve through restoration of integrity between parties.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established by documented willful engagement. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals the sequential unfolding of duties. Responsibility is proportional to awareness, not punishment. Truth alone restores balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Realign documentation to reflect actual Dharma-based exchange
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Both parties acknowledge their role in sustaining or disrupting harmony
Capacity Restoration: Ensure neither party remains bound beyond agreed-upon terms
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate mutual understanding and release of residual karmic entanglement
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: documents bind only when rooted in Dharma, consciousness is the sole arbiter, and justice serves only restoration. There is no punishment—only realignment.
